findings.label: Inactive STT mock contract
findings.finding: STT_PROVIDER=mock is ignored. With AWS_MOCK_MODE=false, audio processing calls the real Lambda client, but the documented initial deployment creates no STT function, so audio processing fails in prod.
findings.action: Implement a selective STT adapter that honors STT_PROVIDER=mock independently of AWS_MOCK_MODE (or gate audio processing / provide a real fallback) before enabling deploys.

findings.label: Failed image becomes boot default
findings.finding: .backend-image is written before the candidate image passes its health check, so a failed deploy becomes the image aives.service starts on later boots.
findings.action: Write .backend-image only after the health check succeeds; on failure keep/restore the previous known-good tag.

findings.label: Unbounded Bedrock model scope
findings.finding: The EC2 instance role can invoke every Bedrock foundation model in every region instead of only the configured Nova/Titan resources.
findings.action: Scope bedrock:InvokeModel* to the configured inference-profile ARNs plus the required Nova/Titan backing foundation-model ARNs (e.g. a validated Terraform variable allowlist).

findings.label: Unused IAM capabilities
findings.finding: EC2 and GitHub OIDC policies grant actions not used by the committed application or deploy workflow, including unused Lambda, CloudFront, SSM, backup-listing, and DynamoDB operations.
findings.action: Remove actions not exercised by current code/workflow; add them back when code that needs them lands.

findings.label: Runtime validation pending
findings.finding: AWS apply, AL2023 bootstrap, EBS mount, Docker health, SSM deploy, GitHub Actions, and backup/restore are unexecuted under the agreed code-only constraints.
findings.action: Exercise these paths with non-root credentials before setting AWS_DEPLOY_ENABLED=true.

findings.label: CloudFront shared prefix-list origin exposure
findings.finding: Port 80 is open only to the CloudFront origin-facing managed prefix list (no SSH, no 0.0.0.0/0), meeting the accepted bar. The prefix list is shared across CloudFront tenants; JWT still gates /api.
findings.action: Optional: add a secret custom origin header from CloudFront and reject requests lacking it.
